newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore trade in light buying for TSR20 rubber.
newsitem.headline: Singapore trade in light buying for TSR20 rubber.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet by midday on Friday with some players engaged in very mild covering for TSR20 rubber, dealers said.

"The deals were done in the ring session for TSR20 rubber by some local players and the volume is very small, actually. It's a typical morning market with people sitting on the sidelines waiting for any kind of lead," a dealer said.
The volume traded reached a meagre 120 tonnes broken down into 40 tonnes each for the July, August and September TSR20 contracts. The other rubber grades were untraded in the morning session.
"That was just some people doing some shortcovering. The big boys were not in the market. If they do show up, they will wait for the afternoon session," a dealer said.

Traders said the market may also drift through the afternoon in thin dealings ahead of the weekend. Easier prices in Japan, with the key November contract down 0.7 yen to 136.5, kept people on the sidelines.
At 0445 GMT, July RSS3 was indicated at 115.00 U.S. cents a kg from 116.25 cents. July TSR20 was seen steady at 153.50 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg.
